question: Chad Hurley and Steve Chen are computer innovators credited with co-founding _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__YouTube__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **YouTube**

 
 
• YouTube is a Google-owned online video sharing and social media network based in the United States.
 
• On **February 14, 2005**, it was officially introduced.
 
• Steve Chen, Chad Hurley, and Jawed Karim established YouTube.
 
• YouTube was purchased by **Google** for $1.65 billion in October **2006**.**​**
